abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 343 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 391 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 423 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
